name: Beef Chimichurri Bowl with Quinoa-Rice Medley, Cucumber Tomato Salad & Pickled Onion (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Place vinegar, honey, and salt in a small bowl, then stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
red wine vinegar
1 tsp honey
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the quinoa and rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup quinoa
½ cup jasmine rice
1 ½ cups water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ small bunch cilantro
½ English cucumber
1 pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook quinoa and rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley and cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place herbs in another small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the herbs along with oil, vinegar, and spices, then stir to combine the chimichurri. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
extra virgin olive oil
red wine vinegar
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain pears and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (425 g) can sliced pears, in juice

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g lean ground beef
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp red wine vinegar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add half to the plate with the pears. Add remaining tomatoes to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of rice and quinoa, 1 cup of beef, pears, and tomatoes between plates.

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice and quinoa, beef, salad, and pickled onions between bowls, then drizzle with chimichurri. Enjoy!
